data.one_liner: Highlight app widgets step by step with tooltips to create interactive feature tutorials.
data.what_it_does: A package that helps you guide users through your application by highlighting specific UI widgets sequentially. It automatically scrolls targets into view, supports custom tooltips, and provides configurable animations and transition effects.
use_when: You want to guide new users through your app's main features via a step-by-step walkthrough.
You need to highlight specific UI elements and present descriptive tooltips on demand.
avoid_when: You require complex multi-page onboarding flows that are completely separate from the core UI.
Your application does not use widgets that can be uniquely referenced for target rendering.
strengths: Great performance optimizations in v5.x with reduced memory usage and higher FPS.
Handles scrolling target widgets into view automatically.
Supports custom tooltip widgets and multiple simultaneous showcases.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on correct context and render state for proper showcase positioning.
May require adjustments if target widgets are inside dynamic or complex scrolling views.
